scenarios.title: Qualification manifest, report, threshold, and audit/gate contracts

failure.impact: The release verdict or defect ledger cannot be trusted.
failure.proposed_fix: Repair the versioned manifest/report contract and add a regression case before using the gate.

scenarios.title: Packed candidate install, initialization, context, lifecycle, and migration flow

failure.impact: The installable release does not preserve the repository-tested lifecycle or context contract.
failure.proposed_fix: Reproduce from the packed tarballs, attribute the failing phase, and repair the published package boundary.

scenarios.title: Installed candidate mixed-scope task through completed public lifecycle

failure.impact: The installable release cannot prove a normal product change through planning, implementation, deterministic verification, evaluator review, commit, and finish.
failure.proposed_fix: Reproduce the isolated installed-package fixture, repair the first failing public lifecycle phase, and preserve the stale-envelope and cleanup shields.

scenarios.title: Direct and branch_pr lifecycle state matrix

failure.impact: At least one supported task-management state or workflow route is unsafe or inconsistent.
failure.proposed_fix: Use the failing focused test as the reproducer and repair the shared state-machine projection before release.

scenarios.title: Automatic context-layer freshness, provenance, conflict, and budget matrix

failure.impact: The executor may receive stale, excessive, unattributed, conflicting, or insufficient context.
failure.proposed_fix: Repair the failing context resolver/projection path and preserve deterministic source attribution.

scenarios.title: Managed runner and compact external-agent supervisor protocol

failure.impact: External agents still reconstruct or execute lifecycle shell choreography and the default UX bypasses the canonical supervisor.
failure.proposed_fix: Add task advance --agent-json over the task-run state machine, compact its packet to 2048 bytes, and route onboarding away from semantic begin/complete shortcuts.

scenarios.title: Shared supervisor state-machine parity and evidence outcomes

failure.impact: Managed and external execution can produce different lifecycle or evidence truth for the same task.
failure.proposed_fix: Move both frontends onto one typed transition engine and add a matched trace assertion for the failing state.

scenarios.title: Interruption, ambiguity, replay, stale authority, hosted wait, and cleanup recovery

failure.impact: A failed or ambiguous task episode can repeat side effects, accept stale authority, or become unrecoverable.
failure.proposed_fix: Repair the failing recovery transition and retain the exact state fingerprint/effect evidence in its regression test.

scenarios.title: PR publication, checks, merge, hosted close, and release boundary matrix

failure.impact: Local task truth can diverge from GitHub or publication truth.
failure.proposed_fix: Repair the failing hosted boundary adapter and preserve remote readback evidence before closeout.

scenarios.title: Matched provider-token, quality, and structural-hash evidence

failure.impact: The release cannot substantiate its provider-token savings or semantic quality on the exact candidate revision.
failure.proposed_fix: Capture matched exact-revision evidence, then remove attributed token or outcome regressions without reducing verified-success quality.

scenarios.title: Deterministic CLI cold and wall-time latency guards

failure.impact: Formal CLI preparation exceeds the historical absolute threshold in the current environment; a matched baseline decides release impact.
failure.proposed_fix: Correlate the absolute result with the matched v0.6.26 comparison before attributing a product regression.

scenarios.title: Interleaved v0.6.26 versus packed-candidate CLI latency

failure.impact: The packed candidate is slower than published 0.6.26 on the same fixture, Node runtime, host, and interleaved sample sequence.
failure.proposed_fix: Use the per-command matched deltas to remove duplicated startup, Git, task-index, or context work from the candidate hot path.

scenarios.title: Packed public supervisor latency versus published v0.6.26

failure.impact: The packed public supervisor adds more than 10% median or p95 overhead versus the semantically equivalent v0.6.26 path.
failure.proposed_fix: Attribute duplicated Git, route, task, or context observations and optimize them without weakening stale-state or effect-safety checks.

scenarios.title: Repository contract, type/tooling, architecture, and baseline guards

failure.impact: The candidate violates a required source, policy, architecture, formatting, or maintained-baseline contract.
failure.proposed_fix: Attribute the first failing contract and repair it without weakening the maintained guard.

scenarios.title: Critical CLI behavior suite

failure.impact: A release-critical CLI contract is broken.
failure.proposed_fix: Repair the first failing critical CLI behavior and preserve its focused regression test.

scenarios.title: TypeScript candidate build and type contract

failure.impact: The candidate does not compile under the pinned TypeScript toolchain.
failure.proposed_fix: Repair the reported type boundary without weakening strictness or changing the pinned toolchain during release qualification.

scenarios.title: Workflow runtime coverage and harness matrix

failure.impact: A formal workflow transition lacks executable coverage or violates its coverage threshold.
failure.proposed_fix: Add or repair the smallest deterministic workflow scenario and keep the matrix synchronized.

scenarios.title: Candidate repository diagnostics

failure.impact: The release candidate diagnoses its own repository state as invalid.
failure.proposed_fix: Resolve the reported repository/configuration invariant and rerun doctor on the exact candidate revision.

scenarios.title: Release task registry and closeout state

failure.impact: The release candidate still contains unfinished or invalid task truth.
failure.proposed_fix: Finish or explicitly disposition release-scoped tasks and rerun the task-state contract on the exact release revision.

scenarios.title: Bounded Codex semantic qualification: 50 runs and 55 provider episodes

failure.impact: The candidate lacks complete no-retry semantic quality and token telemetry from the exact runtime or a proven provider-runtime-equivalent descendant.
failure.proposed_fix: Classify the failed episode without retrying it, repair the attributable product defect, and run a new explicitly versioned candidate generation unless the runtime is provably unchanged.
